name: Adventurer's Guild, Main Room
desc1: Here lies the meeting room of the infamous Adventurer's Guild. If thou
desc2: seekest adventure and glory, this is the best place to start. Through
desc3: the flickering light you notice all types of men and women, from lowly
desc4: sires listening anxiously to the tales being told, to a darkly cloaked
desc5: wizard sitting melodramatically in the corner. To the north a hallway
desc6: leads to the Guild's offices, and to the south, the training rooms. A
desc7: board on the wall holds a few posted messages.
